one_line: Rebel artillery commander and key leader of Delhi’s defence in 1857.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, sturdy, broad-shouldered with a seasoned soldier’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, thick brows, strong nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard; default expression intent and resolute, eyes narrowed as if weighing tactics.
appearance.hair: Black hair, kept short and mostly hidden under a deep-red quilted turban with a slightly conical profile, wrapped firmly with a narrow dark-gold band near the base.
appearance.costume: Mid-19th-century Indo-Muslim officer’s dress: long knee-length quilted green angarkha-style coat with front overlap and cloth buttons, subtle vertical stitching, worn over a cream cotton kurta and loose white pyjama trousers; a broad dark-red cotton patka sash tightly wrapped at the waist with the ends hanging to the left, leather belt over the sash holding a simple brass buckle; dark-brown leather ankle-high boots, and a light-brown cotton shawl draped from left shoulder to back for dust protection; minimal jewellery, just a plain silver ring on right hand.
appearance.signature: An iron 1850s smoothbore artillery officer’s sword with a simple brass hilt and slightly curved steel blade, held or sheathed at his left hip, often accompanied by a rolled hand-sketched map in his right hand.

ref_desc: Bakht Khan is a mid-40s sturdy, bearded North Indian rebel officer with a deep-red conical turban, green quilted angarkha coat over cream kurta and white pyjamas, dark-red waist sash, brown boots, carrying a brass-hilted curved sword and rolled map in deep red, green, cream and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Bakht Khan as a mid-40s sturdy North Indian rebel artillery commander: oval medium-brown face, thick brows, strong nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, expression intent and resolute. His black hair is short and mostly hidden under a deep-red quilted conical turban wrapped with a narrow dark-gold band. He wears a knee-length dark-green quilted angarkha-style coat with front overlap and cloth buttons, over a cream cotton kurta and loose white pyjama trousers. A broad dark-red cotton sash is wrapped tightly at his waist with the ends hanging to the left, and a simple leather belt with brass buckle sits over it. He has dark-brown leather ankle-high boots and a light-brown cotton shawl draped from his left shoulder across his back. Show a plain silver ring on his right hand. At his left hip is a sheathed iron smoothbore artillery officer’s sword with a simple brass hilt and slightly curved steel blade, and in his right hand he holds a rolled hand-sketched map. Use a palette dominated by deep red, dark green, cream, white and dark brown, and present him front-facing in a neutral stance suitable as a model sheet.
